## 4.1.30 (HexGhoul): Arima, phase 2 part 3: close combat, precise rushes, dodges

HexKagune 4.1.30 for Forge 1.20.1. Not tested in game. Preview: `docs/handoff/arima-close-4.1.30.png` (his rush and his sidesteps, front,
side, three-quarter and above).

Your words: "He can dash more precisely. He's way more precise. His entire moveset changes because he no longer has the Dawn weapon. So
he's more into a melee close combat type ... He will always try to, get into range and kill you. He'll dodge moves. He will be a fucking
monster basically."

**What it was (4.1.29):** with his blade he walked in at a run and swung once you were in reach.

**Now:**
- **The rush:** out of reach (up to 12 blocks) and in sight, he charges straight at you, low, the blade lowered ahead, and **stops exactly
  where his blade reaches** (it follows you as you move, never overshoots), then his string starts the moment he arrives.
- **Dodges:** an arrow, a thrown thing, a fireball, Ukaku's fire or crystal coming at him (the same prediction Rinkaku's tendril shield
  uses), or a kagune blow aimed at him (most of the time): he sidesteps square to it, to the side of its line he's already on (the other
  side if that's blocked), giving up a blow still in its windup, and comes straight back at you.
- Once a blow is about to land he's committed: no dodging out of it.
- Close combat only: none of Dawn's lightning, soaring shots or ground strike in this phase.

**Next for Arima:** the end (the blade shatters, he falls to his knees, then dies).
